strengths: The final offer now has an upward cup and a clearer outward position rather than the former small thumb-like raised-hand silhouette. At 240 px and in the complete 390 px stage, both themes make the hand's separate role easier to see. The improvement is earned through wrist position/rotation with unchanged mitten geometry, rather than added anatomy.

The offer arrives after the visitor-facing return. Source and all sampled 2350/2500/2620/2720 ms states support a single outward/upward move into the held cup; the free hand stays quiet and the endpoint holds through 4100 ms. This strengthens the existing ending without adding another wave or requiring an afterthought.

The phone correction is limited to the part of the story that needs the project question. Gaze begins adapting after the antenna cue, head support follows, consideration remains a hold, and all staging influence is zero by the 2350 ms visitor return. The 390 px day/night series and 320 px before/current comparisons show a more upright, upward-attending inspection than the baseline lateral/downward relation.

The desktop relationship remains restrained: the before/current 1440 px samples preserve the established side-by-side cause of attention, while a cached measured bearing supplies the phone adaptation. The page and question stay stationary; the fix does not turn layout into another performer.

Thinking leaves the chin-contact hand as the only high hand action, with its free mitten quieter and lower. Focused has two separated low hands. Grateful's lower clasp no longer competes as strongly with the ruff band, while Shy retains a modest asymmetry and Worried a diagonal hand relationship. The pose families remain the same little character rather than six new poses designed around bigger limbs.

Warm Investigate & share remains the finite lead, with wry and one-peek still separate studies. No added punchline is required to explain the clearer offer. The source retains native deliberate Play, static/reduced-motion handling, bounded active-time retargeting and exact returned poses, protecting the editorial pause and the user's control over the performance.
